description: This source file is a script for managing and running vitest profiling commands, including argument parsing, directory resolution, command building, and execution logic. It handles profiling modes and outputs, and wraps execution with process spawning.

methods.name: parseArgs
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments to determine mode and output directory, with validation.

methods.name: resolveVitestProfileDir
methods.description: Resolves the directory for vitest profiling output based on provided mode and optional output directory.

methods.name: buildVitestProfileCommand
methods.description: Builds the command and arguments for running vitest profiling in specified mode.
